_note: DEV STUB written by Claude for local tests only; replaced by text/k3.json from self-hosted K3. Never ships.
rule_units: STUB: on-hand is in eaches; CS lines convert with the pack size in effect on the effective date.
rule_cutoff: STUB: a line counts only if its effective date is on or before {cutoff}; posting date does not matter.
rule_count: STUB: COUNT sets on-hand as of end of its effective date; lines effective on or before it are not applied.
rule_void: STUB: VOID cancels the referenced line; neither has effect.
rule_lines: STUB: RECEIPT adds, SHIPMENT removes, ADJUST adds the signed quantity.
rule_returns: STUB: RETURN is in eaches; restock only if resaleable as new, else scrap.
rule_transfers: STUB: sender removes shipped qty only if the matching XFER-IN is effective on or before {cutoff}; receiver adds its XFER-IN qty.
note_wrong_sku: STUB: line {line} booked to {wrong} by mistake; goods were {right}; count it for {right2}.
note_consignment: STUB: line {line} is consignment stock of {vendor}; do not count.
note_duplicate: STUB: line {line} duplicates line {orig}; ignore it.
opening_heading: STUB opening balances at end of {date}
intro: STUB: {company} has {n} warehouses ({first} to {last}); report ending on-hand per SKU for {start} to {cutoff}.
